headline: Reserve Bank of India Conducts Treasury Bills Auction Across Three Tenors
summary: The Reserve Bank of India detailed auction outcomes for 91-day, 182-day, and 364-day Treasury bills, recording total competitive bids exceeding 76,000 crore rupees.
why: The Reserve Bank of India manages central bank operations, monetary policy, and public debt sales for the government of India.

impacts.name: India Government Sovereign Yields
impacts.why: The RBI finalized cut-off yields across short-term government money market instruments.
